name: Aurora
lineage: Round 1 concept 1 — warm modern firm, later reworked to a 'column banking-precision' light palette
signature: Drifting aurora gradient blobs in the hero (kept subtle), scroll-orchestrated reveals, count-up stats, infinite marquee
description: A calm, premium light theme: blue-tinted paper canvas with deep-indigo primary buttons and one rationed ember-orange accent. Banking-precision columns, hairline mist borders and soft indigo shadows keep it modern-firm rather than stuffy.

name: Courtroom
lineage: Round 1 concept 2 — became the winning direction; iterated as v2 and v3
signature: Gold cursor spotlight, word-by-word kinetic headlines, blinking-cursor serif hero, sticky horizontal-scroll process section
description: Editorial, literary dark theme — 'an NYT-Magazine profile of a courtroom drama'. Near-black ink with cream type, rationed gold and oxblood, thin-weight Cormorant Garamond display and rule-line structure.

name: Courtroom v2
lineage: iteration 2 of courtroom — same palette, adds ProcessSection/ProcessVariants experiments and SpectrumMatrix
signature: Courtroom look with alternative horizontal-process section variants trialled
description: Refinement pass on Courtroom: identical dark ink/cream/gold/oxblood tokens, but the process section was rebuilt in multiple scroll variants and the dispute spectrum matrix was introduced.

name: Courtroom v3 (Spotlight)
lineage: iteration 3 of courtroom — the finalised 'Courtroom / Spotlight' design, extracted into the endispute-live repo and deployed
signature: Gold cursor spotlight over the full courtroom system: kinetic serif headlines, sticky horizontal process, spectrum matrix
description: The winning concept, polished for production: anchor scroll-padding, Process + SpectrumMatrix components and reduced-motion fallbacks. Extracted into endispute-live and shipped as endispute.com.au.

name: Mosaic
lineage: Round 1 concept 3 — 'Atlas Card' sapphire system
signature: 3D-tilt bento cells, magnetic buttons, blend-mode custom cursor, draggable horizontal timeline
description: AI-startup polish on a serious firm: pure-black canvas stepped through grey surfaces (depth by tone, never shadows), a single brightened sapphire accent and hairline white borders.

name: Ledger
lineage: Round 2 refined concept 1 — 'End Your Dispute.' archival case-file
signature: Indexed case-file layout: numbered sections 00–08, coordinate markers, monospace accents, barely-there verdigris focus wash
description: A near-monochrome editorial law-journal on warm parchment (never pure white): graphite ink, faint hairlines and a Legora-style indexed grid. Type does the heavy lifting — Cormorant Garamond display over Inter body.

name: Verdict
lineage: Round 2 refined concept 2 — 'Two sides. One resolution.'
signature: Split-screen duality hero — two full-bleed obsidian sides with text hugging the central seam, one signal-red accent
description: Obsidian tonal steps (no pure black surfaces) with exactly one signal red for CTAs and highlights. The split-screen layout dramatises two parties resolving into one structured space.

name: Atrium
lineage: Round 2 refined concept 3 — 'Resolve with clarity.', refined toward a Parloa warm-paper reference
signature: Airy architectural spacing on uncoated cream paper; highlighter-orange used ONLY as outline/underline/icon-stroke, never fills; near-zero radius, flat surfaces
description: Light, open and architectural — warm cream canvas with linen banding, hairline rules and Fraunces display. Clarity and relationship-preservation expressed as generous whitespace and zero shadows.

name: Quill
lineage: Round 2 refined concept 4 — 'In the matter of your dispute… let it be resolved.'
signature: Manuscript/letterpress formality: parchment wash, Cormorant SC small-caps, animated quill progress and a wax-seal motif, oxblood selection
description: The most formal voice — a legal document rendered as a warm paper manuscript. EB Garamond body (self-hosted via next/font), small-caps display accents, oxide-red and antique-gold details.

name: Meridian
lineage: Round 2 refined concept 5 — 'From conflict to resolution.', earlier star-field build kept in archive/
signature: Directional journey layout: starfield + constellation waypoints with mouse glow guiding the eye from conflict to resolution; CTA-forward with the phone number front and centre
description: A cosmic dark theme — pure space black with panel tones, a violet 'gold' accent and teal counter-tone. Ultra-thin Newsreader display headlines over a scroll-driven waypoint journey.

name: Clause
lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — the living contract
signature: A living contract that writes, signs and resolves itself as you read: ink underlines, quill trails, 1px ledger rules, paper-speckle texture
description: Warm parchment manuscript with ink-black type and a single rationed oxblood seal-red for signature, seal and one CTA, plus faint gold hairlines. Flat separation by rules only — never heavy shadow.

name: Constellation
lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — palette distilled from the Dala reference
signature: Particle cosmos: thousands of tiny line-drawn shapes on a fixed canvas that cluster, scatter and re-form from conflict into resolution
description: Pure black void, bone type, violet pulse and amber/lichen illustration tints. The whole page floats over a generative constellation canvas.

name: Convergence
lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — marries Verdict's split layout with Equilibrium's force-lattice art
signature: Two parties (ash + red threads) weave into one behind the Verdict-style split-screen measure layout, under a legibility vignette
description: Obsidian surfaces with the single signal-red scheme, a living force-lattice breathing behind Caslon serif headlines. Uses Verdict's .measure container grammar over a fixed canvas.

name: Equilibrium
lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6); its ForceLattice art was saved separately for future exploration
signature: Two opposing force-fields — teal vs amber nodes on a flow field — resolve into one woven lattice on scroll; the cursor weaves and brightens nearby threads; agreement links in indigo
description: Cool architectural dark with depth from tone only: night-blue surfaces, hairline grid, electric indigo bridging CTAs between the two party hues.

name: Tribunal
lineage: Round 3 art-site explorations (fable6) — the living scales of justice
signature: A brass balance whose scales tip and settle into equilibrium as you scroll, one warm metallic gold for scales + CTA, faint cool blue counter-tone
description: Near-black void with tonal charcoal surfaces and whisper-weight Cormorant Garamond display gravitas. The animated brass scales carry the whole identity.

name: Corporate Blue (v1)
lineage: single-file HTML exploration round (Apr 2026), version 1 of 5
description: Classic trustworthy corporate design: cool slate-blue sections on an off-white canvas, deep steel-blue primary with teal and a restrained gold secondary accent.

name: Gmux Organic (v2)
lineage: single-file HTML exploration round (Apr 2026), version 2 of 5 — styled after gmux.ai
signature: Paper-grain texture via layered radial gradients, deep-green ink on cream paper with dark forest sections
description: Organic paper-and-ink take on the gmux.ai look: cream paper canvas with subtle green/rust grain, Fraunces serif display, JetBrains Mono details and full dark-surface counterpart tokens.

name: Dark Elegant Gold (v3)
lineage: single-file HTML exploration round (Apr 2026), version 3 of 5 — precursor of the Courtroom gold-on-black direction
description: Dark elegant gold-on-charcoal with warm ivory type and Playfair Display headings — an early single-file ancestor of the Courtroom palette that eventually shipped.

name: Modern Minimal Rust (v4)
lineage: single-file HTML exploration round (Apr 2026), version 4 of 5
description: Strictly reduced: near-black ink on off-white, a single rust-orange accent, hairline rules and Manrope's geometric sans throughout. No ornament, all typography.

name: Law Firm Navy Premium (v5)
lineage: single-file HTML exploration round (Apr 2026), version 5 of 5
description: Traditional premium law-firm look: cream body with deep navy hero/section bands, antique gold accents, and a double-serif system (Cormorant Garamond display over Source Serif 4 body).

name: Original WordPress Site
lineage: the legacy live endispute.com.au (WordPress + Salient theme), saved as a browsable mirror; replaced by the endispute-live redesign
description: The client's original WordPress site saved page-by-page (Salient theme, system Cambria serif): white corporate layout whose heaviest accent is a bright gold #d9b310 with navy/cyan support. Kept as the wording baseline all redesigns reuse.

name: Verbose Static Rebuild
lineage: hand-built static rebuild of the original WordPress content (pre-concept phase), documented in VERBOSE_VERSION_PLAN.md / INTERACTIVE_FEATURES.md
description: A dependency-free single-page rebuild of the original site's copy: slate-and-blue SaaS-style tokens with amber warnings, dark navy hero band, service-worker + manifest included. Content source for all later concepts.

name: Force Lattice (Saved Art)
lineage: extracted from site-equilibrium; client flagged it 'really cool and awesome — save and explore later'
signature: Two opposing node fields drifting on a flow field: same-side links in teal/amber, bridging links in indigo; scroll resolves two clouds into one woven, balanced lattice; cursor pulls nodes and brightens threads
description: Canvas art piece (rAF-only, reduced-motion aware) saved alongside its globals reference for reuse as a future hero/poster feature. The dispute metaphor — two parties woven into one agreement — as pure generative art.

name: Business Card — Ledger
lineage: print adaptation of the signature dark Courtroom/Ledger site look; 90x55mm + 3mm bleed, 300 DPI (PDF/PNG twins + ALL-cards.pdf)
signature: Gold rule and monospace coordinate accents on ink black, with a branded QR
description: Dark editorial card carrying the live-site brand (ink, gold #d4a14a, cream, oxblood) — gold hairline rules and Courier-style coordinate details, name set as serif display with italic gold surname.

name: Business Card — Atrium
lineage: print adaptation of the Atrium concept's light palette onto the shared card brand system
signature: Cream card, ink type, gold hairlines, oxblood accent
description: The light-and-airy counterpart: cream stock with ink typography, thin gold rules and a single oxblood detail, plus a decode-verified dark-on-light QR.

name: Business Card — Split
lineage: duality concept from the Verdict direction translated to print
signature: Ink/cream split with the name straddling a gold seam; back carries 'End your dispute with Endispute.'
description: A duality card: half ink, half cream divided by a gold seam the name sits across — the two-sides-one-resolution metaphor as a physical object.

name: Business Card — Minimal Crest
lineage: fourth concept in the business_cards generator suite (scripts/make_cards.py)
signature: Circled 'E' monogram crest with generous negative space
description: The restrained option: lots of empty stock, a circled-E monogram crest and small serif contact block — quiet luxury for formal correspondence.

name: Endispute Live
lineage: production extraction of site-2-courtroom-v3 ('Courtroom / Spotlight') into its own repo; deployed on Cloudflare Pages
signature: Gold cursor spotlight courtroom system plus production additions: Publications section, SpectrumMatrix, PWA manifest/icons, contact API
description: The shipped endispute.com.au: the dark ink/cream/gold/oxblood Courtroom identity finalised with anchor scroll offsets, publications, spectrum matrix of dispute processes and Cloudflare Functions for contact/tracking.
